verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ በዕለት ፡ እንተ ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ተኪሎታ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ወቀብአ ፡ ወቀደሳ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ንዋያ ፡ ወምሥዋዕኒ
                  ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ንዋዩ ፡ ወቀብኦሙ ፡ ወቀደሶሙ ፤
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the day in which Moses finished the setting-up of the tabernacle, that he anointed it, and consecrated it, and all its furniture, and the altar and all its furniture, he even anointed them, and consecrated them.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass in the day in which Moses finished the setting-up of the tabernacle, that he anointed it, and consecrated it, and all its furniture, and the altar and all its furniture, he even anointed them, and consecrated them.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
translations.ron: Când a aşezat Moise cortul şi l-a miruit şi l-a sfinţit pe el şi toate lucrurile lui, jertfelnicul şi toate obiectele lui, şi le-a miruit şi le-a sfinţit,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ συνετέλεσε Μωυσῆς, ὥστε ἀναστῆσαι τὴν σκηνήν, καὶ ἔχρισεν αὐτὴν, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτὴν, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔχρισεν αὐτὰ, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτά.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽኡ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ዘዘ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ እሉ ፡ ውእቶሙ ፡
                  መላእክተ ፡ ነገዶሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ተሠይሙ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምስፍናሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the princes of Israel brought gifts, twelve princes of their fathers' houses: these were the heads of tribes, these are they that presided over the numbering.

translations.lxx: And the princes of Israel brought gifts, twelve princes of their fathers' houses: these were the heads of tribes, these are they that presided over the numbering.
translations.kjv: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
translations.ron: Atunci au venit cele douăsprezece căpetenii ale lui Israel, capii familiilor lor, mai-marii seminţiilor, care supravegheaseră numărătoarea,
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκαν οἱ ἄρχοντες Ἰσραὴλ, δώδεκα ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν· οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες φυλῶν, οὗτοι οἱ παρεστηκότες ἐπὶ τῆς ἐπισκοπῆς.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽኡ ፡ ቍርባኖሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፤ ስድስቱ ፡ ሰረገላት ፡ ሠናያን ፡ ወዐሠርቱ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡ አልህምት ፡
                  ለለአሐዱ ፡ ሰረገላ ፡ በበክልኤቱ ፡ አልህምቱ ፡ ዘሰረገላት ፡ እምነ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወሶር ፡ እምኀበ ፡
                  አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፤ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ደብተራ ።
verses.translation: And they brought their gift before the Lord, six covered waggons, and twelve oxen; a waggon from two princes, and a calf from each: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

translations.lxx: And they brought their gift before the Lord, six covered waggons, and twelve oxen; a waggon from two princes, and a calf from each: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
translations.kjv: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
translations.ron: Şi au adus Domnului darurile lor, şase care acoperite şi doisprezece boi, câte un car de fiecare două căpetenii şi câte un bou de fiecare căpetenie şi le-au adus înaintea cortului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤνεγκαν τὸ δῶρον αὐτῶν ἔναντι Κυρίου, ἓξ ἁμάξας λαμπηνίκας, καὶ δώδεκα βόας· ἅμαξαν παρὰ δύο ἀρχόντων, καὶ μόσχον παρὰ ἑκάστου· καὶ προσήγαγον ἐναντίον τῆς σκηνῆς.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: A grăit Domnul lui Moise zicând:
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ንሣእ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ወይኩን ፡ ዘይትቀነይ ፡ ለምግባረ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ለለ፩እምኔሆሙ ፡
                  በከመ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ።
verses.translation: Take of them, and they shall be for the works of the services of the tabernacle of witness: and thou shalt give them to the Levites, to each one according to his ministration.

translations.lxx: Take of them, and they shall be for the works of the services of the tabernacle of witness: and thou shalt give them to the Levites, to each one according to his ministration.
translations.kjv: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
translations.ron: "Primeşte-le de la ei, ca să fie pentru facerea lucrărilor trebuitoare la cortul adunării şi le dă leviţilor, potrivit cu felul slujbei fiecăruia".
translations.grk: λάβε παρʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔσονται πρὸς τὰ ἔργα τὰ λειτουργικὰ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου· καὶ δώσεις αὐτὰ τοῖς Λευίταις, ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ λειτουργίαν.

verses.geez: ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ውእተ ፡ ሰረገላ ፡ ወአልህምቶኒ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ።
verses.translation: And Moses took the waggons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

translations.lxx: And Moses took the waggons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
translations.kjv: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
translations.ron: Şi Moise, luând carele şi boii, le-a dat leviţilor:
translations.grk: Καὶ λαβὼν Μωυσῆς τὰς ἁμάξας καὶ τοὺς βόας, ἔδωκεν αὐτὰ τοῖς Λευίταις.

verses.geez: ፪ሰረገላተ ፡ ወ፬አልህምተ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ በአምጣነ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ።
verses.translation: And he gave two waggons and four oxen to the sons of Gedson, according to their ministrations.

translations.lxx: And he gave two waggons and four oxen to the sons of Gedson, according to their ministrations.
translations.kjv: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
translations.ron: Două care şi patru boi a dat fiilor lui Gherşon, după slujba lor;
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰς δύο ἁμάξας καὶ τοὺς τέσσαρας βόας ἔδωκε τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσὼν κατὰ τὰς λειτουργίας αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወ፬ሰረገላተ ፡ ወ፰አልህምተ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሜራሪ ፡ በአምጣነ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ይታመር ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሮን
                  ፡ ካህን ፡ እሙንቱ ።
verses.translation: And four waggons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari according to their ministrations, by Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

translations.lxx: And four waggons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari according to their ministrations, by Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.kjv: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.ron: Patru care şi opt boi a dat fiilor lui Merari, după slujba lor, sub povaţa lui Itamar, fiul lui Aaron, preotul.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰς τέσσαρας ἁμάξας καὶ τοὺς ὀκτὼ βόας ἔδωκε τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρὶ κατὰ τὰς λειτουργίας αὐτῶν, διὰ Ἰθάμαρ υἱοῦ Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἱερέως.

verses.geez: ወለደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓትሰ ፡ ኢወሀቦሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ፡ ወበመትከፍቶሙ ፡ ይጸውርዎ ።
verses.translation: But to the sons of Caath he gave them not, because they have the ministrations of the sacred things: they shall bear them on their shoulders.

translations.lxx: But to the sons of Caath he gave them not, because they have the ministrations of the sacred things: they shall bear them on their shoulders.
translations.kjv: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
translations.ron: Iar fiilor lui Cahat nu le-a dat, pentru că slujba lor era de a duce lucrurile sfinte, pe care trebuia să le poarte pe umeri.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Καὰθ οὐ δέδωκεν, ὅτι τὰ λειτουργήματα τοῦ ἁγίου ἔχουσιν· ἐπʼ ὤμων ἀροῦσι.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽኡ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ለመድቅሐ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ በዕለት ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ቀብአ ፡ አምጽኡ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ቍርባኖሙ ፡
                  ቅድመ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And the rulers brought gifts for the dedication of the altar, in the day in which he anointed it, and the rulers brought their gifts before the altar.

translations.lxx: And the rulers brought gifts for the dedication of the altar, in the day in which he anointed it, and the rulers brought their gifts before the altar.
translations.kjv: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
translations.ron: Au mai adus căpeteniile jertfe pentru sfinţirea jertfelnicului, în ziua miruirii lui, şi au înfăţişat căpeteniile prinoasele lor înaintea jertfelnicului.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκαν οἱ ἄρχοντες εἰς τὸν ἐγκαινισμὸν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἔχρισεν αὐτὸ, καὶ προσήνεγκαν οἱ ἄρχοντες τὰ δῶρα αὐτῶν ἀπέναντι τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ መልአክ ፡ ለለ ፡ ዕለቱ ፡ ያብእ ፡ ቍርባኖ ፡ መልአክ ፡ በበ ፡
                  ዕለቶሙ ፡ ለመድቅሐ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, One chief each day, they shall offer their gifts a chief each day for the dedication of the altar.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, One chief each day, they shall offer their gifts a chief each day for the dedication of the altar.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Domnul către Moise: "Câte o căpetenie pe fiecare zi să aducă prinosul său pentru sfinţirea jertfelnicului".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, ἄρχων εἷς καθʼ ἡμέραν, ἄρχων καθʼ ἡμέραν προσοίσουσι τὰ δῶρα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν ἐγκαινισμὸν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου.

verses.geez: ወዘያበውእ ፡ በቀዳሚት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ቍርባኖ ፡ ነአሶን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሚናዳብ ፡ መልአኮሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ይሁዳ ።
verses.translation: And he that offered his gift on the first day, was Naasson the son of Aminadab, prince of the tribe of Juda.

translations.lxx: And he that offered his gift on the first day, was Naasson the son of Aminadab, prince of the tribe of Juda.
translations.kjv: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
translations.ron: În ziua întâi a adus darul său Naason, fiul lui Aminadab, căpetenia seminţiei lui Iuda.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν ὁ προσφέρων ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πρώτῃ τὸ δῶρον αὐτοῦ, Ναασσὼν υἱὸς Ἀμιναδὰβ, ἄρχων τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα.

verses.geez:
ወአብአ ፡ ቍርባኖ ፤ መጽብሕ ፡ ዘብሩር ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ዘምእተ ፡ ወሠላሳ ፡ ሐሳቡ ፡ ወአሐዱ ፡ ፍያል ፡ ዘብሩር ፡ ዘሰብዓ
                  ፡ በሰቅሎን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በሰቅል ፡ ዘቅዱስ ፡ ወክልኤሆሙ ፡ ምሉኣን ፡ ስንዳሌ ፡ ዘግቡር ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ለ[መሥዋዕት] ።
verses.translation: And he brought his gift, one silver charger of a hundred and thirty shekels was its weight, one silver bowl, of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour kneaded with oil for a meat-offering.

translations.lxx: And he brought his gift, one silver charger of a hundred and thirty shekels was its weight, one silver bowl, of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour kneaded with oil for a meat-offering.
translations.kjv: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
translations.ron: şi darul lui a fost: un blid de argint în greutate de o sută treizeci de sicli şi o cupă de argint de şaptezeci de sicli, după siclul sfânt, amândouă pline cu făină de grâu, amestecată cu untdelemn, pentru jertfă;
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκε τὸ δῶρον αὐτοῦ, τρυβλίον ἀργυροῦν ἕν, τριάκοντα καὶ ἑκατὸν ὁλκὴ αὐτοῦ· φιάλην μίαν ἀργυρᾶν, ἑβδομήκοντα σίκλων κατὰ τὸν σίκλον τὸν ἅγιον· ἀμφοτέρα πλήρη σεμιδάλεως ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ εἰς θυσίαν.

verses.geez: ወጻሕል ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ዘዐሥሩ ፡ ወርቁ ፡ ወምሉእ ፡ ዕጣ[ነ] ።
verses.translation: One golden censer of ten shekels full of incense.

translations.lxx: One golden censer of ten shekels full of incense.
translations.kjv: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
translations.ron: O cădelniţă de aur de zece sicli, plină cu miresme;
translations.grk: Θυΐσκην μίαν δέκα χρυσῶν, πλήρη θυμιάματος.

verses.geez:
ላህም ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አልህምት ፡ [ወበግዕ ፡] ኣሐዱ ፡ [ወማሕስአ ፡ በግዕ ፡ አሐዱ ፡] ዘዓመት ፡ ለመሥዋዕት
                  ።
verses.translation: One calf of the herd, one ram, one he-lamb of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering;

translations.lxx: One calf of the herd, one ram, one he-lamb of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering;
translations.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
translations.ron: Un viţel, un berbec şi un miel de un an pentru ardere de tot;
translations.grk: Μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν, κριὸν ἕνα, ἀμνὸν ἕνα ἐνιαύσιον εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα,

verses.geez: ወሐርጌ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: and one kid of the goats for a sin-offering.

translations.lxx: and one kid of the goats for a sin-offering.
translations.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
translations.ron: Un ţap, jertfă pentru păcat;
translations.grk: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez:
ወለመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ዕጐልት ፡ ወኀምስቱ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ወኀምስቱ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ ወ፭አባግዕ ፡ አንስት ፡ ዘዘ
                  ፡ ዓመት ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቍርባኑ ፡ ለነአሶን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሚናዳብ ።
verses.translation: And for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two heifers, five rams, five he goats, five ewe-lambs of a year old: this was the gift of Naasson the son of Aminadab.

translations.lxx: And for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two heifers, five rams, five he goats, five ewe-lambs of a year old: this was the gift of Naasson the son of Aminadab.
translations.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

translations.lxx: One calf of the herd, one ram, one he-lamb of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering,
translations.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
translations.ron: Un viţel, un berbec şi un miel de un an pentru arderea de tot;
translations.grk: Μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν, κριὸν ἕνα, ἀμνὸν ἐνιαύσιον ἕνα εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα,

verses.geez: ወሐርጌ ፡ ፩እምውስተ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: and one kid of the goats for a sin-offering.

translations.lxx: and one kid of the goats for a sin-offering.
translations.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
translations.ron: Un ţap, jertfă pentru păcat;
translations.grk: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez:
ወለመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ክልኤ ፡ እጐልት ፡ ወ፭አባግዕ ፡ ወ፭አጣሊ ፡ ወ፭አባግዕ ፡ አንስት ፡ [ዘዘ ፡ ዓመት ፡]
                  ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቍርባኑ ፡ ለፋጌሔል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኤክራን ።
verses.translation: And for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two heifers, five rams, five he-goats, five ewe-lambs of a year old: this was the gift of Phageel the son of Echran.

translations.lxx: And for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two heifers, five rams, five he-goats, five ewe-lambs of a year old: this was the gift of Phageel the son of Echran.
translations.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
translations.ron: Iar pentru jertfa de împăcare: doi boi, cinci berbeci, cinci ţapi şi cinci miei de un an. Acestea sunt darurile lui Paghiel, fiul lui Ocran.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰς θυσίαν σωτηρίου δαμάλεις δύο, κριοὺς πέντε, τράγους πέντε, ἀμνάδας ἐνιαυσίας πέντε· τοῦτο τὸ δῶρον Φαγεὴλ υἱοῦ Ἐχράν.

verses.geez: ወአመ ፡ ዐሡሩ ፡ ወሰኑይ ፡ አብአ ፡ መልአኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ንፍታሌም ፡ አኪሬ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኤናን ፡ ቍርባኖ ።
verses.translation: On the twelfth day the prince of the sons of Nephthali, Achire the son of Ænan.

translations.lxx: On the twelfth day the prince of the sons of Nephthali, Achire the son of Ænan.
translations.kjv: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
translations.ron: În ziua a douăsprezecea a adus căpetenia fiilor lui Neftali, Ahira, fiul lui Enan.
translations.grk: Τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δωδεκάτῃ ἄρχων τῶν υἱῶν Νεφθαλί, Ἀχιρὲ υἱὸς Αἰνάν.

verses.geez:
መጽብሕ ፡ ፩ዘብሩር ፡ ዘ፻ወ፴ሐሳቡ ፡ ወፍያል ፡ ፩ዘብሩር ፡ ዘ፸በሰቅሎን ፡ በሰቅል ፡ ዘቅዱስ ፡ ወክልኤሆሙ ፡ ምሉኣን ፡
                  ስንዳሌ ፡ ዘግቡር ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: He brought his gift, one silver charger, its weight a hundred and thirty shekels; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering.

translations.lxx: He brought his gift, one silver charger, its weight a hundred and thirty shekels; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering.
translations.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
translations.ron: Darurile lui au fost: un blid de argint în greutate de o sută treizeci de sicli şi o cupă de argint de şaptezeci de sicli, după siclul sfânt, amândouă pline cu făină de grâu, amestecată cu untdelemn, pentru jertfă;
translations.grk: Τὸ δῶρον αὐτοῦ, τρυβλίον ἀργυροῦν ἓν, τριάκοντα καὶ ἑκατὸν ὁλκὴ αὐτοῦ· φιάλην μίαν ἀργυρᾶν, ἑβδομήκοντα σίκλων κατὰ τὸν σίκλον τὸν ἅγιον· ἀμφότερα πλήρη σεμιδάλεως ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ εἰς θυσίαν.

verses.geez: ወጻሕል ፡ ፩ዘ፲ወርቁ ፡ ወምሉእ ፡ ዕጣነ ።
verses.translation: One golden censer of ten shekels, full of incense.

translations.lxx: One golden censer of ten shekels, full of incense.
translations.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
translations.ron: O cădelniţă de aur de zece sicli, plină cu miresme;
translations.grk: Θυΐσκην μίαν δέκα χρυσῶν, πλήρη θυμιάματος.

verses.geez: ወላህም ፡ ፩እምውስተ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ወበግዕ ፡ ፩ወማሕስአ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ፩ዘዓመት ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: One calf of the herd, one ram, one he-lamb of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering,

translations.lxx: One calf of the herd, one ram, one he-lamb of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering,
translations.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
translations.ron: Un viţel, un berbec şi un miel de un an pentru ardere de tot;
translations.grk: Μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν, κριὸν ἕνα, ἀμνὸν ἕνα ἐνιαύσιον εἰς ὁλόκαύτωμα,

verses.geez: ወሐርጌ ፡ ፩እምውስተ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: and one kid of the goats for a sin-offering.

translations.lxx: and one kid of the goats for a sin-offering.
translations.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
translations.ron: Un ţap, jertfă pentru păcat;
translations.grk: καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez:
ወለመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ፪እጐልት ፡ ወ፭አባግዕ ፡ ወ፭አጣሊ ፡ ወ፭አባግዕ ፡ አንስት ፡ [ዘዘ ፡ ዓመት ፡] ዝንቱ ፡
                  ውእቱ ፡ ቍርባኑ ፡ ለአኪሬ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኤናን ።
verses.translation: And for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two heifers, five rams, five he-goats, five ewe-lambs of a year old: this was the gift of Achire the son of Ænan.

translations.lxx: And for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two heifers, five rams, five he-goats, five ewe-lambs of a year old: this was the gift of Achire the son of Ænan.
translations.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
translations.ron: Iar pentru jertfa de împăcare: doi boi, cinci berbeci, cinci ţapi şi cinci miei de un an. Acestea sunt darurile lui Ahira, fiul lui Enan.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰς θυσίαν σωτηρίου δαμάλεις δύο, κριοὺς πέντε, τράγους πέντε, ἀμνάδας ἐνιαυσίας πέντε· τοῦτο τὸ δῶρον Ἀχιρὲ υἱοῦ Αἰνάν.

verses.geez:
ከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መድቅሐ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዘአመ ፡ ቀብኦ ፡ ዘእምኀበ ፡ መላእክቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፤ መጽብሕ ፡
                  ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡ ዘብሩር ፡ ወፍያል ፡ ዘብሩር ፡ ፲ወ፪ወጻኅል ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ፲ወ፪ ።
verses.translation: This was the dedication of the altar in the day in which Moses anointed it, by the princes of the sons of Israel; twelve silver chargers, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden censers:

translations.lxx: This was the dedication of the altar in the day in which Moses anointed it, by the princes of the sons of Israel; twelve silver chargers, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden censers:
translations.kjv: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
translations.ron: Acestea au fost darurile din partea căpeteniilor lui Israel, aduse la sfinţirea jertfelnicului, în ziua miruirii lui: douăsprezece blide de argint, douăsprezece cupe de argint, douăsprezece cădelniţe de aur,
translations.grk: Οὗτος ὁ ἐγκαινισμὸς τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἔχρισεν αὐτὸ, παρὰ τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ· τρυβλία ἀργυρᾶ δώδεκα, φιάλαι ἀργυραῖ δώδεκα, θυΐσκαι χρυσαῖ δώδεκα.

verses.geez:
ወለለ ፡ ፩መጽብኅ ፡ ፻ወ፴በሰቅሎን ፡ ወ፸በሰቅሎን ፡ ለለ፩ፍያል ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ብሩሩ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ንዋይ ፡ ዕሥራ ፡ ምእት
                  ፡ ወአርባዕቱ ፡ ምእት ፡ ሰቅል ፡ በሰቅሎ ፡ ዘቅዱስ ።
verses.translation: each charger of a hundred and thirty shekels, and each bowl of seventy shekels: all the silver of the vessels was two thousand four hundred shekels, the shekels according to the holy shekel.

translations.lxx: each charger of a hundred and thirty shekels, and each bowl of seventy shekels: all the silver of the vessels was two thousand four hundred shekels, the shekels according to the holy shekel.
translations.kjv: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
translations.ron: Având fiecare blid o sută treizeci sicli de argint şi fiecare cupă câte şaptezeci de sicli; deci argintul tot în aceste vase a fost două mii patru sute sicli, după siclul sfânt;
translations.grk: Τριάκοντα καὶ ἑκατὸν σίκλων, τὸ τρυβλίον τὸ ἕν, καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα σίκλων ἡ φιάλη ἡ μία· πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον τῶν σκευῶν, δισχίλιοι καὶ τετρακόσιοι σίκλοι· σίκλοι, ἐν τῷ σίκλῳ τῷ ἁγίῳ.

verses.geez:
ወዐሠርቱ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡ አጽሕልት ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ እለ ፡ ምሉኣን ፡ ዕጣነ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ወርቆሙ ፡ ለውእቶሙ ፡ አጽሕልት ፡
                  ምእት ፡ ወዕሥራ ፡ ወርቆሙ ።
verses.translation: Twelve golden censers full of incense: all the gold of the shekels, a hundred and twenty shekels.

translations.lxx: Twelve golden censers full of incense: all the gold of the shekels, a hundred and twenty shekels.
translations.kjv: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
translations.ron: Douăsprezece cădelniţe de aur, pline cu miresme, de câte zece sicli fiecare, după siclul sfânt; deci tot aurul cădelniţelor a fost o sută douăzeci de sicli;
translations.grk: Θυΐσκαι χρυσαῖ δώδεκα πλήρεις θυμιάματος· πᾶν τὸ χρυσίον τῶν θυϊσκῶν, εἴκοσι καὶ ἑκατὸν χρυσοῖ.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ዘመሥዋዕት ፡ ፲ወ፪አልህምት ፡ ወአባግዕ ፡ ፲ወ፪ወማሕስአ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ፲ወ፪ዘዘ ፡ ዓመት ፡
                  ለመሥዋዕትኒ ፡ ወለሞጻሕትኒ ፡ ወ፲ወ፪ሐራጊት ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: All the cattle for whole-burnt-offerings, twelve calves, twelve rams, twelve he-lambs of a year old, and their meat-offerings, and their drink-offerings: and twelve kids of the goats for sin-offering.

translations.lxx: All the cattle for whole-burnt-offerings, twelve calves, twelve rams, twelve he-lambs of a year old, and their meat-offerings, and their drink-offerings: and twelve kids of the goats for sin-offering.
translations.kjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
translations.ron: Pentru arderi de tot au fost: doisprezece viţei din vitele mari, doisprezece berbeci şi doisprezece miei de un an şi împreună cu ei prinosul de pâine şi turnarea lor; doisprezece ţapi, jertfă pentru păcat;
translations.grk: Πᾶσαι αἱ βόες αἱ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωσιν, μόσχοι δώδεκα, κριοὶ δώδεκα, ἀμνοὶ ἐνιαύσιοι δώδεκα, καὶ αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν, καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν· καὶ χίμαροι ἐξ αἰγῶν δώδεκα περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez:
ወለመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ዕሥራ ፡ ወአርባዕቱ ፡ እጐልት ፡ ወአባግዕ ፡ ስሳ ፡ ወአጣሊ ፡ ፷ወአባግዕ ፡ አንስት ፡ ዘዘ
                  ፡ ዓመት ፡ ንጹሓት ፡ ፷ ፤ ከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መድቅሐ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ቀብአ ።
verses.translation: All the cattle for a sacrifice of peace-offering, twenty-four heifers, sixty rams, sixty he-goats of a year old, sixty ewe-lambs of a year old without blemish: this is the dedication of the altar, after that Moses consecrated Aaron, and after he anointed him.

translations.lxx: All the cattle for a sacrifice of peace-offering, twenty-four heifers, sixty rams, sixty he-goats of a year old, sixty ewe-lambs of a year old without blemish: this is the dedication of the altar, after that Moses consecrated Aaron, and after he anointed him.
translations.kjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
translations.ron: Iar pentru jertfa de împăcare au fost: douăzeci şi patru de boi, şaizeci de berbeci, şaizeci de ţapi şi şaizeci de miei de un an, fără meteahnă. Acestea au fost darurile la sfinţirea jertfelnicului, după miruirea lui.
translations.grk: Πᾶσαι αἱ βόες εἰς θυσίαν σωτηρίου, δαμάλεις εἰκοσιτέσσαρες, κριοὶ ἑξήκοντα, τράγοι ἑξήκοντα ἐνιαύσιαι, ἀμνάδες ἑξήκοντα ἐνιαύσιοι ἄμωμοι· αὕτη ἡ ἐγκαίνωσις τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου, μετὰ τὸ πληρῶσαι τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ, καὶ μετὰ τὸ χρίσαι αὐτόν.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ይበውእ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትናገሮ ፡ ወሰምዐ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡
                  ይትናገሮ ፡ እምነ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ምሥሃል ፡ ዘዲበ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ ኪሩብ ፡ ወይትናገር
                  ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
verses.translation: When Moses went into the tabernacle of witness to speak to God, then he heard the voice of the Lord speaking to him from off the mercy-seat, which is upon the ark of the testimony, between the two cherubs; and he spoke to him.

translations.lxx: When Moses went into the tabernacle of witness to speak to God, then he heard the voice of the Lord speaking to him from off the mercy-seat, which is upon the ark of the testimony, between the two cherubs; and he spoke to him.
translations.kjv: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
translations.ron: Când a intrat Moise în cortul adunării, ca să grăiască cu Domnul, a auzit un glas, care-i grăia de sus de pe chivotul legii, dintre cei doi heruvimi. Glasul acela grăia cu el.
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι Μωυσῆν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου λαλῆσαι αὐτῷ, καὶ ἤκουσε τὴν φωνὴν Κυρίου λαλοῦντος πρὸς αὐτὸν ἄνωθεν τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου, ὅ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τῆς κιβωτοῦ τοῦ μαρτυρίου, ἀναμέσον τῶν δύο χερουβίμ· καὶ ἐλάλει πρὸς αὐτόν.
